OpenAI sues Apple over alleged trade-secret theft

• OpenAI alleges former Apple staff stole dozens of confidential hardware files after moving back to Apple.
• Q.ANT's photonic chips, piloted with IONOS, aim to reduce AI energy use by handling complex calculations with light-based processing.
• Lausd temporarily disabled Google ai overviews on student devices to keep content age-appropriate.

High-effort AI reviewers cut false acceptance of bad patches but still let at least 45 % slip through.

• Researchers evaluated Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 as AI code reviewers on 90 Django patches generated by coding agents.
• High effort consistently reduced false acceptance of bad patches compared with low effort, though no setting eliminated errors entirely.
